AG Zoom · Odoo Integration

Official API documentation: 📄 Download API Documentation (PDF)

1) Connection (Remote Control)

Type: REST · Base URL: http://visor.ag-zoom.com

connection_params (JSON):

{
  "client_id": "your_client_id",
  "client_secret": "your_client_secret",
  "username": "user@example.com",
  "password": "*******"
}
  • Get Token calls /oauth/v2/token using OAuth2 password grant and stores bag["access_token"].
  • Get devices (plan) and Get readings send Authorization: Bearer <access_token>.

2) Device Discovery and Manual Configuration

For initial setup or when adding new AgZoom devices, use the List Devices procedure to discover available devices and configure them manually in Odoo.

What does this procedure do?

The "AgZoom: List Devices for Support" procedure performs the following actions:

  1. Authenticates with AgZoom API using your OAuth2 credentials
  2. Retrieves all devices available in your AgZoom account from /api/userdevices
  3. Fetches detailed sensor data for each device including sensor codes and available ids
  4. Extracts device name, ID, location, sensors, and all available measurement units
  5. Generates a comprehensive JSON file with complete device and sensor configuration
  6. Attaches the JSON to the Remote Control record for download

This procedure only reads data from AgZoom - it does not create or modify anything in Odoo.

3) Default Procedure

  1. Get Token → obtain OAuth2 token and store it in the bag.
  2. Get devices (plan) → build bag["sensors_plan"] from device/sensor configuration.
  3. Get readings → call /api/getsensordata/{deviceId}/date/{endDate}/{startDate} with date filters and upsert readings.

4) Device Configuration

In each Device (mdm.measurement.device) set remotecontrol_params:

{
  "agzoom_device_id": "12345",
  "start_date": "2025-10-13"
}

5) Sensor Configuration

In each Sensor (mdm.measurement.device.sensor) set remotecontrol_params:

{
  "sensor_code": "5632",
  "id": "1",
  "start_date": "2025-10-13"
}

Complete Configuration Examples

Example: Soil moisture sensors

Device configuration:

{
  "agzoom_device_id": "425",
  "start_date": "2025-05-24"
}

Sensor 1 (soil moisture - VP-4 sensor, port 5, depth 30cm):

{
  "sensor_code": "5632",
  "id": "1",
  "start_date": "2025-05-24"
}

Sensor 2 (soil temperature - same physical sensor):

{
  "sensor_code": "5632",
  "id": "temperature_water",
  "start_date": "2025-05-24"
}

6) API Structure & Data Extraction

AgZoom returns data in this format:

{
  "status": "0",
  "systemDate": "17-11-2025 11:30:35",
  "filter": "DATE",
  "initialDate": "2025-10-17T08:00:07Z",
  "finalDate": "2025-10-02T08:30:07Z",
  "device": {
    "id": 5523,
    "costumer": "Baix Ter-Lisimetres",
    "farm": "Lisimietres",
    "name": "AGD901_25",
    "sensors": [{
      "code": "36546",
      "type": "GEN CTD-10",
      "port": 5,
      "variables": [
        {
          "id": 1,
          "type": "Nivel Agua",
          "data": "-1",
          "unit": "water_level",
          "unit_default": "mm (milímetros)",
          "date": "2025-10-17T08:00:07Z",
          "mrid": 0
        },
        {
          "id": 2,
          "type": "Temperatura",
          "data": "19.9",
          "unit": "temperature_water",
          "unit_default": "ºC (Celsius)",
          "date": "2025-10-17T08:00:07Z",
          "mrid": 0
        }
      ]
    }]
  }
}

Configuration Mapping:

  • sensor_code → identifies the physical sensor (e.g., "36546")
  • unit → identifies the specific unit within that sensor (e.g., "water_level", "temperature_water")
  • The system searches for the sensor by code and then extracts all variables that match the specified unit
  • Important note: The variables[] array contains multiple readings with different dates for the same sensor

7) Time Window & Filtering

  • Get devices (plan) calculates initial_date per sensor: last reading date → else sensor.start_date → else device.start_date → else January 1st of current year.
  • Get readings calls /api/getsensordata/{deviceId}/date/{endDate}/{startDate}
  • Date format for URL is: YYYYMMDDHHIISS (e.g., 20251017083007)
  • Response format: Dates in the response come in ISO 8601 format with UTC: 2025-10-17T08:00:07Z
  • Dates are automatically converted to Odoo format for storage: 2025-10-17 08:00:07

Available Units in Sensor Data

Use these values in the "unit" field of sensor configuration. These are the unit names returned by the AgZoom API:

Common Measurement Units

  • water_level - Water level / Soil moisture
  • temperature_water - Water temperature
  • temperature_soil - Soil temperature
  • conductivity - Electrical conductivity
  • electrical_conductivity - Electrical conductivity (alternative)
  • Pluviometria - Precipitation / Rainfall
  • pressure - Atmospheric pressure
  • water_level_relative - Relative water level

Note: Specific unit values depend on your AgZoom configuration and installed sensors. Use the "List Devices" procedure and check the complete API response from /api/getsensordata to see which units are available for your specific sensors.

8) Troubleshooting

  • Missing token error: Ensure "Get Token" action is active and runs first (sequence = 10)
  • No sensors found: Check that sensors have valid remotecontrol_params and are linked to devices
  • Missing OAuth2 credentials: Make sure to configure client_id, client_secret, username and password in connection_params
  • No readings inserted: Verify date window filters, sensor_code and unit values
  • Date format error: AgZoom requires YYYYMMDDHHIISS format (e.g., 20240529000000)

Sequence order: Get Token (10) → Get devices (20) → Get readings (30)

# Action C: fetch readings from AgZoom API and upsert Remote = self.remote_id SensorModel = env['mdm.measurement.device.sensor'] plan = bag.get('sensors_plan') or [] access_token = bag.get('access_token') if not access_token: raise Exception("Missing access_token in bag") headers = {'Authorization': 'Bearer %s' % access_token, 'Accept': 'application/json'} final_date = fields.Date.today() window_start_suffix = ' 00:00:00' window_end_suffix = ' 23:59:59' total_upserts = 0 total_errors = 0 items = [] for sensor_plan in plan: sensor_id = sensor_plan['sensor_id'] device_id = sensor_plan['device_id'] agzoom_device_id = sensor_plan['agzoom_device_id'] sensor_code = sensor_plan['sensor_code'] id = sensor_plan['id'] initial_date = sensor_plan['initial_date'] sensor_record = SensorModel.browse(sensor_id) # Format dates for AgZoom: YYYYMMDDHHIISS end_date_str = final_date.replace('-', '') + '235959' start_date_str = initial_date.replace('-', '') + '000000' # AgZoom URL: /api/getsensordata/{deviceId}/date/{endDate}/{startDate} base = (base_url or '').rstrip('/') + '/api/getsensordata/%s/date/%s/%s' % (agzoom_device_id, end_date_str, start_date_str) try: resp = request_retry('GET', base, headers=headers, timeout=timeout) code = resp.status_code full_url = getattr(resp, 'url', base) if code < 400: payload = resp.json() or {} status = payload.get('status', '-1') if status != '0': items.append({'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'agzoom_device_id': agzoom_device_id, 'status': code, 'error': 'AgZoom API error status: %s' % status, 'url': full_url}) continue data_list = [] # AgZoom structure: device (object, not array) -> sensors[] -> variables[] device_data = payload.get('device', {}) if device_data and isinstance(device_data, dict): sensors_array = device_data.get('sensors', []) # Find the sensor by code for sensor_item in sensors_array: if str(sensor_item.get('code', '')) == sensor_code: variables = sensor_item.get('variables', []) # Find all variables with matching id (can be multiple with different dates) for variable in variables: if str(variable.get('id', '')) == id: timestamp = variable.get('date', '') value = variable.get('data', '') if timestamp and value: data_list.append({'ts': timestamp, 'value': value}) window_start = initial_date + window_start_suffix window_end = final_date + window_end_suffix upserts = 0 errs = 0 readings_summary = [] for reading in data_list: ts_s = reading['ts'] valf = float(reading['value']) # Convert ISO 8601 timestamp to comparable format (remove Z and T for comparison) ts_comparable = ts_s.replace('T', ' ').replace('Z', '') if (ts_comparable >= window_start) and (ts_comparable <= window_end): try: Remote.upsert( 'mdm.measurement.device.sensor.reading', {'sensor_id': sensor_record.id, 'measurement_time': ts_comparable}, {'value': valf, 'remotecontrol_origin_id': Remote.id} ) upserts += 1 readings_summary.append({'ts': ts_comparable, 'value': valf}) except Exception as e: errs += 1 readings_summary.append({'ts': ts_comparable, 'value': valf, 'error': str(e)}) total_upserts += upserts total_errors += errs items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'agzoom_device_id': agzoom_device_id, 'status': 200, 'url': full_url, 'points_found': len(data_list), 'upserts': upserts, 'errors': errs, 'sensor_code': sensor_code, 'id': id, 'readings': readings_summary, }) else: items.append({'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'agzoom_device_id': agzoom_device_id, 'status': code, 'error': (resp.text or '')[:400], 'url': full_url}) except Exception as e: items.append({'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'agzoom_device_id': agzoom_device_id, 'status': -1, 'error': str(e)}) audit = {'executed_at': fields.Datetime.now(), 'final_date': final_date, 'total_upserts': total_upserts, 'total_errors': total_errors, 'items': items} try: audit_json = json.dumps(audit, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2, default=str) b64 = base64.b64encode(audit_json.encode('utf-8')) except Exception as json_error: simple_audit = {'executed_at': str(fields.Datetime.now()), 'total_upserts': total_upserts, 'total_errors': total_errors, 'error': str(json_error)} audit_json = json.dumps(simple_audit, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2) b64 = base64.b64encode(audit_json.encode('utf-8')) fname = 'agzoom_readings_fetch_%s.json' % fields.Datetime.now().replace(':','').replace('-','').replace(' ','_') att = env['ir.attachment'].create({'name': fname, 'datas_fname': fname, 'datas': b64, 'mimetype': 'application/json', 'res_model': 'remotecontrol', 'res_id': Remote.id}) Remote.message_post(body=u"[AgZoom Readings] upserts=%s errors=%s" % (total_upserts, total_errors), attachment_ids=[att.id]) bag['upserts'] = total_upserts bag['errors'] = total_errors bag['audit_attachment_id'] = att.id
